ideas.pitch: A real-time auction simulation and strategy optimization platform built for Code Auction competitors to test bidding algorithms and token allocation.
ideas.title: BidCraft Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Code Auction is entirely focused on strategy and resource allocation during competitive programming; a platform that lets teams backtest their bidding strategies against simulated opponents directly targets the core meta of this hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A tactical overlay and tracking app designed to manage token currency, Power Card cooldonws, and optimal problem-value calculations in real time.
ideas.title: PowerCard Tracker & Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since teams must strategically manage virtual currency between programming problems and Power Cards like Extra Time, Hint, Double Points, and Steal, a dedicated tactical companion app gives a tangible competitive edge during the live event.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic pricing engine that predicts problem point-to-cost ratios using historical auction data and difficulty metrics to guide real-time team bidding.
ideas.title: CodeMarket Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced statistical modeling akin to forecasting winners to solve the economic optimization problem of when to bid high versus save tokens for Power Cards.

ideas.pitch: An LLM-powered assistant trained on competitive programming problem types to instantly estimate solution difficulty and recommend optimal token bids.
ideas.title: AuctionStrat AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly assists with the auction-based decision-making aspect of the event, offering teams an automated second opinion on whether a problem is worth buying or if they should save currency for a Steal card.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative command center for 4-person teams to split problem coding tasks, monitor token balances, and coordinate Power Card deployments on a single screen.
ideas.title: TeamSync WarRoom
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on frictionless team coordination, ensuring that members can efficiently communicate problem progress and resource constraints during a high-pressure 24-48 hour live event.
